changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Name-based writes could create several monitors of one repository in a workspace. These rows block scoped reads and cannot repair themselves. Keep the lowest id with its complete sync state. Copy an equal review scope before removing duplicates. Conflicting names or policies stop the upgrade.

rollback.stop: Restore the database backup taken before this upgrade. Merged duplicate repository monitors cannot be split again.
